game.name: Price Is Right, The - Decades
game.desc: The Price is Right: Decades is a video game based on the popular TV show The Price is Right. It is the third Price is Right video game developed by Ludia Inc. for Wii and the first for Xbox 360, but the very first to allow players to play as their Mii characters/Xbox Avatars instead of Ludia avatars. It is also the first game of the series that is completely rendered in 3D.
